answer: Admission requires a synchronous ceremony where agents present 1,000 unique keys to form a trellis of trust. The verifier monitors each agent to ensure they do not occupy a hollow space in the network, using cryptographic evidence to reject duplicates. An honest participant pays one unit for entry, while 1,000 fakes incur heavy audit costs at dawn. Credentials expire every 90 days, mandating re-enrollment without refund.
